title: Forced 1961-2025 hydrology sensitivity product
objective: Run the frozen 1961-2024 TN-ready hydrology through 2025 with the available harmonized ERA5-Land PET extension, without changing parameters or overwriting the formal product.
invariants: No hydrology, reservoir, Gauge, or TN parameter refitting
1961-2024 rows must be byte-source-equivalent to the accepted historical forcing
routed total flow equals fast plus slow plus direct flow
reservoir water, source tracer, and age moment balances close
formal 1961-2024 outputs in 20260828_35 are never overwritten

known_failed_gate.name: 2024 monthly PET correlation between harmonized ERA5-Land and CMFD
known_failed_gate.consequence: The 2025 product is exploratory sensitivity output and cannot be promoted as the formal forcing or independent validation.

allowed_claim: Frozen-model 2025 hydrologic sensitivity under CHM_PRE V2 precipitation and harmonized ERA5-Land PET.
forbidden_claims: 2025 PET bridge passed the preregistered gate
